Name: Treasure Hunt
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds treasures chests and bags that can be opened for treasure!

You can use keys to open chests and shears to open bags:
[spoiler]
Copper Key can open Wooden Chest.

Iron Key can open Wooden Chest + Red Chest.

Golden Key can open all chests.

Shears can open coin bags.

Hold the key and right-click on the chest to open it.

or if opening a bag

Hold the shears and right-click on the bag to open it.
[/spoiler]

Increase your foraging level to find even better chests:
[spoiler]
Level 2 unlocks coin bags.

Level 4 unlocks wooden chests.

Level 6 unlocks red chests.

Level 8 unlocks golden chests.
[/spoiler]

Chests are buried in the ground and can be found in various locations:
[spoiler]
Use the hoe tool on artifact spots to hunt for treasure!

Town
Beach
Mountain
Forest
Secret Woods
Desert
Island South
Island Southeast
Island North
Island West
[/spoiler]

All chests can give coins:
[spoiler]
Coin Bag: 35G

Wooden Chest: 50G 

Red Chest: 75G

Golden Chest: 100G
[/spoiler]

Loot will change and increase when different keys are used:
[spoiler]
Wooden Chest:
Copper Bar - max 3.
Geode - max 3.
Coin Bag if a iron/gold key is used.

Red Chest:
Iron Bar - max 3.
Frozen Geode - max 2.
Magma Geode - max 2.
Diamond if gold key is used.
Coin Bag.

Golden Chest:
Gold Bar - 2.
Iridium Bar - 1.
Pearl - 1.
Omni Geode - 2.
Coin Bag.
[/spoiler]

Clint sells keys, but you can also craft them as your foraging level increases:
[spoiler]
Level 1 unlocks Copper Key.

Level 2 unlocks Iron Key.

Level 3 unlocks Golden Key.

Copper Key requires 1 Copper Bar + 1 Quartz.

Iron Key requires 1 Iron Bar + 1 Quartz.

Golden Key requires 1 Gold Bar + 1 Fire Quartz.
[/spoiler]

Keys can be recycled for ores.
[spoiler]
Use a recycling machine.

Recycling a Copper Key can give up to 5 Copper Ore..

Recycling a Iron Key can give up to 5 Iron Ore.

Recycling a Golden Key can give up to 5 Gold Ore.
[/spoiler]

Chests and bags are furniture and can be used as decoration.
